name: wallet-accountant-stand-in-ui-e2e
description: The stand-in UI's browser test (make local-browser-test). It runs only in the mcr.microsoft.com/playwright image, whose tag (PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION in the Makefile) must equal @playwright/test's version. oidc-client-ts is listed so that a version bump fails the test until site/vendor holds the same bundle (make stand-in-ui-vendor).
